### 版本能力汇总 / Release highlights

- 增加认证缓存摘要与原子重建，缓存损坏或被篡改后会拒绝复用并重新生成 / Added authenticated cache digests and atomic rebuilding after corruption or tampering
- 增加 Root 环境兼容与严格策略，严格模式会在每次启动时检查并友好拒绝高风险环境 / Added compatible and strict Root policies with checks on every launch
- Native 运行库按加固任务生成中性别名，并在写入前检测与原 APK 的名称冲突 / Native runtime libraries now use per-task neutral aliases with collision checks
- 桌面端运行环境降低到完整 JDK 8+，证书识别、加固和签名已在 Java 8 正式安装包中完成回归 / Desktop runtime support now starts at a full JDK 8+, verified for certificate inspection, protection, and signing
- 建立 Stub DEX 指标守门和资源能力协议，标准模式与 Android 4.4 工控兼容资源保持协议一致 / Added Stub DEX metric gates and a resource capability protocol shared by standard and Android 4.4-compatible resources
- 完成普通设备、ADB Root、缓存篡改、ARouter、多 DEX、16 KB 与低版本设备矩阵回归 / Completed regression coverage for normal devices, ADB Root, cache tampering, ARouter, multidex, 16 KB pages, and legacy Android

当前版本不包含生产级内存 DEX，也不支持直接加固 AAB；这两项已分别进入后续独立版本规划。

Production in-memory DEX loading and direct AAB protection are not included in this release; both are planned as separate future version themes.
